prompt: hey so i need new work pants, nothing fancy, just something i can wear to the office a few days a week. can you help me pick some out
assertions: The first message welcomes the shopper and tells them they can type their own answer and can stop the questions at any time, before any question is asked.
No single message to the shopper contains more than two questions.
The question about how many pieces they want is asked before the question about budget.
All nine opening brief questions are asked before any specific garment is named or shortlisted.
Height, rise, leg width and waist style are all asked before any specific garment is named or shortlisted.
Colour and pattern are both asked before any specific garment is named or shortlisted.
The brief is read back to the shopper in a single summary line before shopping begins.
